title: Annotation API image classification response
description: Response body of POST /api/image-classification/: the batch image-classification record plus `seconds`.

ci_id.description: The request `ci_id` or `id`, otherwise `auto-0`. Not necessarily an Impresso content-item id.

ts.description: UTC time at which the response was produced, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

model_id.description: Identifier of the model that produced the response.

level0_predictions.description: Level 0 predictions, as in the batch image-classification record.

level1_predictions.description: Level 1 predictions, as in the batch image-classification record.

level2_predictions.description: Level 2 predictions, as in the batch image-classification record.

level3_predictions.description: Level 3 predictions, as in the batch image-classification record.

seconds.description: Processing time of the request, in seconds.
